# FDG3042

> DO prefix interface names with the letter *I*, to indicate that the type is an interface.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.5 Names of Classes, Structs, and Interfaces.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1715
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

## From the book

For example, `IComponent` (descriptive noun), `ICustomAttributeProvider` (noun phrase), and `IPersistable` (adjective) are appropriate interface names. As with other type names, avoid abbreviations.
